newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Protel plans $80 mln IPO in Q4 1998.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Protel plans $80 mln IPO in Q4 1998.

text.p: Mexico's Protel plans a global initial public offering of $80 million during the fourth quarter of 1998, the long-distance telephone company's chief executive officer said on Thursday.

"We are choosing the right time for floating very carefully. It could be in the final quarter of 1998. That is what our bankers have recommended," Benigno Perez, Protel's chief executive officer, told journalists.
"The placement would be around $80 million. I don't think it would reach $90 million," he added.
Grupo Communicaciones San Luis owns a majority stake in Investcom, which markets its products and services through Protel, a company statement said.
